recognizes? We introduce SYNTHETICUNIVERSES, a controlled benchmark that
pairs canonicalfamous worldswith matchedtwisted twinsgoverned by nearby
noncanonical mechanisms. We evaluate each reported law twice: by executing
it on held-out continuations and transfer settings, and by independently checking
whether it recovers the generating mechanism. In the current checkpoint of a
pre-specified 60-cell study, 22 trials were graded and one additional run ended in
infrastructure failure. Among 20 twin trials, 8 pass predictive verification while
5 recover the generator. The dissociation is bidirectional: six parsable outputs
predict successfully while missing the mechanism, whereas three recover the mech-
anism but fail predictive rollout. Drag exhibits the first pattern (5/5 predictive

evidence.excerpt:
Agent.The benchmark is model-agnostic, but the present empirical checkpoint evaluates one
instantiation: a fresh tool-augmented Claude Code sub-agent with Bash, Python, NumPy, SciPy, and
pandas, following the broader tool-using/experiment-agent paradigm [Schick et al., 2023, Huang
et al., 2024]. The single-agent design is intentional at this stage: it isolates evidence updating
before introducing social dynamics from debate, critic, or consensus pipelines. The agent receives a
self-contained task and observation table and may create scratch analyses. Ground-truth law metadata,
graders, simulator source, and prior results are not placed in the run workspace. Because Bash
executes on a shared host, this istask-level content isolation, not an OS security sandbox. Raw
responses and tool traces are retained for audit.

Among the 20 parsable graded trials, the four-quadrant taxonomy contains 4 verified recoveries, 6
predictively adequate alternatives, 3 unstable recoveries, and 7 failed discoveries; two additional
graded responses are reported separately as parser failures. Both off-diagonal quadrants are populated,
so a single binary "success" score would obscure qualitatively different scientific outcomes.

familiar linear drag on simplicity grounds. That reported law still obtained

equations. Repairs were made at the representation layer and regression-tested against preserved
transcripts. The evaluator was then re-run uniformly over the completed set. No scientific answer was
retried because it was wrong, and mechanism labels are computed independently of predictive pass.

missing_information: No reproducible review or selection methodology was detected.

evaluation_independence.corroboration_summary: The two frozen verifiers are computed independently of each other and of the agent's optimization loop, and the manuscript reports both off-diagonal quadrants populated, directly corroborating the dissociation claim.
evaluation_independence.final_evaluation_signal: Headline outcomes are established by a frozen execution-grounded predictive verifier on held-out continuation and transfer trajectories plus a separate frozen executable mechanism checker comparing functional form against the generator.
evaluation_independence.optimization_signal: The agent optimizes its reported law using only the task prompt, observation table, and scientific Python tools; ground-truth metadata, grader code, simulator source, and prior results are excluded from the workspace.

primary.claim_evidence_alignment: Claims are strictly aligned with the empirical findings; the authors explicitly disclaim confirmatory causal attribution of prior conflict penalty and ladder trends due to incomplete cells, confining headline claims to the bidirectional dissociation between predictive adequacy and mechanism recovery.
primary.evaluation_assessment: While the 60-cell study remains partially completed (22 graded trials, 2 famous controls, and 20 twisted twin trials), the evaluation conclusively demonstrates the core methodological point: both off-diagonal quadrants of predictive pass versus mechanism recovery are populated (e.g., Drag achieves 5/5 predictive passes with 1/5 mechanism recovery, whereas Gravity achieves 1/5 predictive passes with 4/5 mechanism recovery).

evaluation_independence.corroboration_summary: Headline outcomes are established via two distinct and independent criteria (execution-based trajectory rollout vs. functional ground-truth mechanism recovery) that are explicitly shown to dissociate.
evaluation_independence.final_evaluation_signal: Independent post-hoc programmatic execution on unseen trajectory rollouts (NRMSE thresholded at 0.10) and an independent algebraic/functional ground-truth mechanism checker.
evaluation_independence.optimization_signal: The autonomous agent (Claude Code sub-agent) optimizes hypothesis selection and equation fitting using standard scientific computing libraries (NumPy, SciPy, pandas) and visible observation tables without access to ground truth metadata or graders.

primary.limitations: The manuscript candidly documents limitations, including the incomplete 60-cell replication matrix, absence of prior-free symbolic baselines, and benchmark-design degeneracies discovered in the Conservation family.
primary.method_assessment: The methodology is thoroughly detailed, employing a frozen dual-axis evaluation that tests equations on held-out continuation and transfer rollouts alongside an independent executable mechanism checker that compares functional form equivalence.
primary.quality_rationale: The paper provides an exemplary level of experimental transparency, rigorous operational definitions, frozen verification rules, and conservative epistemic boundaries explicitly enumerated in a claim ledger.
primary.scoped_contribution: Introduces SYNTHETICUNIVERSES, a benchmark framework pairing canonical physical systems with twisted twin variants, and demonstrates that execution-grounded predictive accuracy and underlying mechanism recovery dissociate bidirectionally in AI scientific discovery.

scholarly_quality.rationale: The paper provides an exemplary level of experimental transparency, rigorous operational definitions, frozen verification rules, and conservative epistemic boundaries explicitly enumerated in a claim ledger.
scholarly_quality.uncertainty: The manuscript candidly documents limitations, including the incomplete 60-cell replication matrix, absence of prior-free symbolic baselines, and benchmark-design degeneracies discovered in the Conservation family.

limitations_or_uncertainty.value: Structured research-card claims use title, abstract/summary, metadata, screening rules, and curation. A separate scholarly-quality assessment used bounded full-text excerpts, but unsupported claim, method, or evidence fields remain unextracted.
